skills.name: yanshi
skills.title: 入口
skills.trigger_zh: 用偃师帮我推进，看看下一步做什么
skills.trigger_en: Use yanshi to move this forward; what should we do next?

skills.name: yanshi-think
skills.title: 想清楚
skills.trigger_zh: 帮我想想怎么做，先别急着写
skills.trigger_en: Help me think this through before coding

skills.name: yanshi-build
skills.title: 动手
skills.trigger_zh: 就按这个改，写完顺手测一下

skills.name: yanshi-debug
skills.title: 排障
skills.trigger_zh: 这个 bug 怎么回事，先帮我查一下
skills.trigger_en: Why is this failing? Help me debug it

skills.name: yanshi-check
skills.title: 验一下
skills.trigger_zh: 提交前帮我看一眼，确认真的能用
skills.trigger_en: Check this before I submit it; does it actually work?

skills.name: yanshi-handoff
skills.title: 交接
skills.trigger_zh: 上下文快满了，整理一下给下个会话
skills.trigger_en: Prepare a handoff for the next session

skills.name: yanshi-retro
skills.title: 记下来
skills.trigger_zh: 复盘一下，把这次踩的坑记到项目里
skills.trigger_en: Capture what went wrong and save the lesson in this project

skills.name: yanshi-ask
skills.title: 思维小命令
skills.moment: 随时插入：first / challenge / trim / ablate / boundary
